blocks.text: This page tracks the Coquitlam MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for September 2026: $971,700 for a typical home, down 6.3% over twelve months.
Coquitlam benchmark prices and trends, September 2026

A typical Coquitlam home carried an MLS® Home Price Index benchmark of $971,700 in September 2026. That is little changed at −1.0% on the month, down 2.8% over three months, down 2.9% over six months and down 6.3% over the year. Over three years it is down 12.7%, and over five years down 4.4%.
The weakest one-year move in Coquitlam was for an apartment homes at −7.3%; the strongest was a townhouse at −6.5%.
The gap between a detached home ($1,584,400) and an apartment ($640,100) is $944,300, and a townhouse ($976,600) sits $336,500 above the apartment benchmark.
Against Greater Vancouver, where the all-home benchmark was $1,075,900, Coquitlam is 9.7% below. Over the year Greater Vancouver moved down 5.5% against down 6.3% here.
Of the 20 areas this board reports, Coquitlam ranks 14 by all-home benchmark, with Burnaby South above it at $972,800 and Maple Ridge below it at $882,600.

Detached homes in Coquitlam: benchmark $1,584,400, little changed at −0.9% in a month, down 3.9% in three months, down 2.5% in six months, down 6.6% in a year, down 11.0% in three years and little changed at −0.6% in five. That is 11.2% below the detached benchmark for Greater Vancouver ($1,784,700).

Townhouse homes in Coquitlam: benchmark $976,600, little changed at −1.2% in a month, down 3.9% in three months, down 3.1% in six months, down 6.5% in a year, down 8.7% in three years and up 6.7% in five. That is 3.9% below the townhouse benchmark for Greater Vancouver ($1,016,700).

Apartment homes in Coquitlam: benchmark $640,100, little changed at −0.9% in a month, down 2.1% in three months, down 4.2% in six months, down 7.3% in a year, down 12.3% in three years and up 1.7% in five. That is 6.2% below the apartment benchmark for Greater Vancouver ($682,500).

faq.q: What is the benchmark price of a home in Coquitlam?
faq.a: In September 2026, a typical Coquitlam home was $971,700, with detached at $1,584,400.

faq.q: Are Coquitlam home prices rising or falling?
faq.a: Coquitlam is down 6.3% over twelve months and down 2.8% over three months.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home is worth?
faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.
